description: Tails kernel and system logs for the lines that mean the machine is hurting, and files them as Oracle signals.
name: log_sentinel

signals.description: A built-in distress group (OOM, kernel panic, BUG, segfault, filesystem error) matched a log line; severity is high.
signals.name: kernel_distress

signals.description: A configured pattern from the patterns tunable matched a log line; the severity comes from the pattern entry (medium unless it declares high).
signals.name: log_pattern_hit
